title: Alameda Island Fridge
description: Sample listing. A sidewalk fridge offering free food to anyone, any time.
short_description: A free community fridge on the island, stocked and cleaned by a neighbourhood crew.
serves: Anyone — free fridge and pantry.

title: Alameda West End School Garden
description: Sample listing. An edible schoolyard used for science lessons during the week and community care on weekends.
short_description: A schoolyard learning garden where students grow food and families help on weekends.
serves: Students and families; weekend volunteer days.

title: Berkeley Public Seed Library
description: Sample listing. A seed-lending collection where members take seeds for the season and return saved seed to keep the catalogue alive.
short_description: Borrow and return open-pollinated seeds — a lending library for seeds hosted in a public branch.
serves: Anyone with a library card; free open-pollinated seeds.

title: Centerville Backyard Growers
description: Sample listing. A private backyard opened to neighbours for shared growing; exact location shared on contact.
short_description: A shared backyard garden run by a few households. Shown at neighbourhood level to protect the host.
serves: A host backyard shared by nearby households.

title: East Bay Permaculture Guild
description: Partner-provided listing. The East Bay Permaculture Guild coordinates garden work parties, housing-connection gatherings, and unconferences across the region.
short_description: Partner-provided: the volunteer-run Guild that stewards this map — monthly meetings, work parties, and unconferences.
serves: The regional network behind this map — 15+ years of gatherings.

title: East Oakland Mutual Aid Collective
description: Sample listing. A horizontal mutual-aid pod matching offers and needs within the neighbourhood.
short_description: A neighbour-to-neighbour network coordinating groceries, rides, and disaster check-ins.
serves: Neighbours coordinating supplies, rides, and care.

title: El Cerrito Neighbourhood Grow Group
description: Sample listing. Residents organise plant swaps and informal garden tours a few times a season.
short_description: A loose neighbourhood group swapping seedlings, produce, and growing advice.
serves: Residents sharing seedlings, harvests, and know-how.

title: Emeryville Regeneration Nonprofit
description: Sample listing. Provides backbone support — grants, insurance, bookkeeping — to grassroots projects.
short_description: A nonprofit that fiscally sponsors and funds small East Bay regeneration projects.
serves: Fiscal sponsorship and grants for local projects.

title: Fremont Seed Swap (paused)
description: Sample listing. Marked inactive: the swap is paused while organisers look for a new host site.
short_description: A seasonal seed swap that is currently on hiatus — listed so neighbours know its status.
serves: Previously hosted seasonal seed swaps.

title: Fruitvale Community Garden
description: Sample listing. A plot-based community garden in Fruitvale with raised beds, a shared tool shed, and open Saturday work days.
short_description: A plot-based neighbourhood garden with shared tool shed and weekly volunteer work days.
serves: Neighbours growing food; open work days for all ages.

title: Gravity Garden Food Forest
description: Partner-provided listing from the East Bay Permaculture Guild. A demonstration food forest; exact address is shared on contact to protect the host.
short_description: Partner-provided: a food forest with monthly volunteer days, a free pantry, and a cob oven. Shown at neighbourhood level.
serves: Neighbours; monthly volunteer days, free pantry, cob oven.

title: Hayward Community Center Garden
description: Sample listing. A city community centre whose grounds include an edible demonstration garden.
short_description: A public community centre with a demonstration garden and rooms open to local groups.
serves: All ages; cooling site and meeting rooms.

title: Hayward Mutual Aid Hotline
description: Sample listing. A phone/online intake where residents post needs and offers; coordinated by volunteers.
short_description: A neighbour-run request line connecting offers of help with people who need it.
serves: Neighbours requesting or offering direct support.

title: Iron Triangle Food Pantry
description: Sample listing. A volunteer-run pantry sharing produce, bread, and shelf-stable staples with neighbours.
short_description: A no-questions-asked food pantry distributing fresh produce and staples twice a week.
serves: Families in Richmond; no ID or proof required.

title: Jingletown Regenerative Skills School
description: Sample listing. A rotating series of practical regeneration workshops open to beginners.
short_description: Hands-on workshops in composting, greywater, and soil building for East Bay residents.
serves: Adults learning composting, water, and soil skills.

title: Richmond Annex Resilience Hub
description: Sample listing. A resilience hub with backup power and air filtration, opened by volunteers during extreme events. Not an emergency service.
short_description: A community building set up as a clean-air and cooling point when conditions get dangerous.
serves: A gathering + supply point during heat, smoke, or outages.

title: San Antonio Food Bank Depot
description: Sample listing. A regional food-bank depot where volunteers sort and pack food for smaller distribution sites.
short_description: A warehouse hub that supplies neighbourhood pantries and fridges across the East Bay.
serves: Partner pantries and large-scale distribution.

title: South Berkeley Community Space
description: Sample listing. A shared community room that local organisers can book for free gatherings and skillshares.
short_description: A donation-based hall available to neighbourhood groups for meetings, classes, and repair cafés.
serves: Groups needing free meeting and workshop space.

title: Temescal Tool Library
description: Sample listing. Borrow shovels, drills, and repair tools for projects at home or in community gardens.
short_description: A lending library of garden, hand, and power tools so neighbours can share instead of buy.
serves: Residents borrowing garden & repair tools.

title: West Berkeley Regenerative Nursery
description: Sample listing. A for-profit nursery that doubles as a learning space for regenerative gardening.
short_description: A small nursery specialising in California natives and compost, with free weekend classes.
serves: Gardeners buying natives and compost; hosts classes.

title: West Oakland Community Fridge
description: Sample listing. A mutual-aid fridge on a sidewalk, kept clean and stocked by a rotating crew of volunteers.
short_description: A free public fridge and pantry shelf, stocked by neighbours, open around the clock.
serves: Anyone — take what you need, leave what you can.
